messages:
Priya (PM): quick design check — on account-scoped billing list, do we show org sparkline + project peek chips or full project rows by default? tickets about project totals vs invoice keep popping up.
Sam (Design): default = org sparkline + 3 project chips (muted). chips expand to rows. keeps list compact and scannable.
Jo (FE): agree. rendering many sparklines hurts mobile. lazy-load detailed series on expand. show "+N" for overflow chips.
Rae (Data): aggregation rule: use sum for spend. show tokens as "12.1k (▲3.4%)" next to value. for sparklines, use simple line with last-point marker.
Morgan (Billing): invoices differ because of credits/proration/allocations. add a small "Why totals differ" link in rail header that opens a modal listing reasons + link to CSV.
Casey (Support): yes please — customers phrase it: "my projects don't add up to my invoice". modal should be plain language + example. we'll add FAQ snippet.
Sam (Design): microcopy suggestion for denom header: "Tokens billed" + tooltip: "Billing units for requests and responses." short and clear.
Jo (FE): accessibility: sparklines need aria-labels like: "Org spend sparkline — last $3,210 — min $900 — max $5,100". tooltip must be keyboard focusable.
Rae (Data): ux nicety: hover over chip shows mini-reconciler: project spend vs invoice-linked amount and link to "View mapping". light-weight popover.
Morgan (Billing): backend note: we can expose invoice_mapping per project, but generating mapping can be heavier — cache for 12-24h and paginate for many projects.
Priya (PM): decisions: 1) condensed org sparkline + up to 3 project chips; 2) "Expand projects" fetches per-project sparklines; 3) add "Why totals differ" modal + chip popover; 4) denom text: "Tokens billed" with tooltip; 5) accessibility: aria labels + keyboard tooltips.
ci-bot: staging build passed: staging/billing-compact-ui #482 :white_check_mark:
Priya (PM): thanks team — I'll update the mock and create tickets. sync on Tuesday for handoff.
